headline: Approval of AHERA inspection services and asbestos training, plus summer work updates at two schools.
summary: Members may take action on the AHERA inspection and asbestos training item. They will also hear updates on Varieur Elementary's unit and on school grounds upkeep.
items: Approval of AHERA inspection services and asbestos training
Jenks Middle School summer work update
Agnes Little Elementary School summer work update
